top_signals.title: Japan’s Biggest Insurers Post $96 Billion in Bond Paper Losses
top_signals.summary: Japan’s four largest life insurers reported that their combined unrealized losses on domestic bonds increased 7% in the three months through June, showing the risks to the industry from soaring interest rates.

top_signals.title: U.S. support for yen increases expectations for September rate rise in Japan
top_signals.summary: Before the coordinated intervention, most analysts were looking to December for the next move higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
